sources.title: Depth-Anything-V2-Small-hf Open-source Monocular Depth Estimation Model ...
sources.snippet: Depth Anything V2 is an advanced model for monocular depth estimation, capable of predicting depth information from a single image. It offers finer details and stronger robustness compared to the V1 version, while being more efficient than Stable Diffusion-based models.
